blocking_findings.finding: DocView does not independently defend the extractedTextAvailable boundary. handlePdfFallback unconditionally stores the reason and switches to Text. If the callback is spuriously invoked while the predicate is false, the viewer disappears and the empty/not-available Text surface replaces its actionable error panel. The test invokes this exact case but asserts only that the notice is hidden, thereby missing the prohibited transition.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Guard handlePdfFallback with the current exact extractedTextAvailable predicate so predicate-false callbacks change neither view nor fallback state. Add a non-vacuous test that spuriously invokes the callback for every false predicate case and verifies the PdfViewer/error surface remains mounted, Text content/sub-state is absent, and no fallback notice appears.

blocking_findings.finding: Asset-route correctness is not proven against handleDocAsset. The helper test explicitly mirrors dirname/basename algebra using invented paths, while the DocView test only inspects query parameters from mocked document payloads. Neither indexes documents nor invokes handleDocAsset nor verifies returned bytes. Consequently nested, recordSourcePath-backed, container-backed, and same-basename sibling resolution could disagree with actual store/resolveAbsoluteDocPath semantics without either suite failing.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Add integration coverage using the real store/config and handleDocAsset: create distinct byte payloads for nested, recordSourcePath-backed, container-backed, and same-basename sibling documents; obtain the API relPath shape, build the production URL, invoke the real endpoint, and assert byte-exact content from the intended indexed source for each URI. Preserve and assert existing containment behavior.

blocking_findings.finding: The required remount/retry and navigation proof is vacuous. The test named 'viewer remount key uses doc.uri' merely checks that an asset URL contains the URI; it neither navigates nor observes mount/unmount identity. The fallback tests only observe that a stub is visible again after returning to Pages, which does not prove a fresh viewer instance. Thus cleanup and retry-on-return/navigation acceptance remains unverified.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Instrument the isolated PdfViewer stub with mount identities and unmount tracking. Prove Text→Pages creates a new instance after fallback, and exercise actual App/route navigation or an equivalent rerender across two PDF locations to prove the old instance unmounts and the new document mounts. Assert notice state clears across navigation.

non_blocking_observations: PDF classification is case-insensitive and independently accepts MIME or extension through isPdfDocument unit coverage; PdfViewer receives exactly assetUrl, downloadUrl, extractedTextAvailable, and onFallback.

The lazy import boundary is render-gated, markdown retains its Source/Rendered control, PDF owns one Pages/Text control, and inspected production code contains no iframe/object/embed or direct pdfjs-dist import.
All four fallback notice strings, hooks, role=status, download-only action, mutual exclusion, and manual persistence/clearing behavior are covered when the predicate is true.
The full web-suite failure matches the durable read-only-sandbox limitation: mkdtempSync under /tmp fails with EROFS before the affected assertion.
coverage_summary: Read the governing repository, serve, and test instructions; canonical spec/task and done state; plan repairs and task-5 Grok prompt/receipt/events; prerequisite SHIP receipts; DocView, helper, lazy seam, deep-link/App remount behavior, handleDocAsset and API relPath semantics; focused tests and full relevant diff. Core rendering and notice behavior is largely present, but predicate-false defense, real route/byte resolution, and actual remount/navigation evidence remain open.
